svg.text: K1b Turning positions T0, H1 and the spindle S: force and time from below
The hob positions turn the vessel, the spindle spins the jug — all driven through welded steel cups, so no seal faces food.
T0: 2.2 kW, H1: 3.5 kW induction · carrier ring Ø 280 on 3 PEEK rollers
ring drive 0–120 rpm, 20 Nm, pinion post in a welded thimble
spindle S: 750 W, 0–6000 rpm, 1.5 Nm, thimble Ø 40 in a drained pocket Ø 170
H2: plain 2.2 kW position, no drive
T0 FROM ABOVE: a loose ring turns the vessel
glass, induction coil below
driven roller = pinion on a magnet sleeve
two idler rollers (PEEK)
carrier ring Ø 280 (loose ware)
board, bowl, plate or pot sits
in the ring and turns with it:
the arm works on one line, the
turning brings each spot to it
SECTION: drive through a welded thimble (no seal)
deck z 850
induction coil
pot / bowl in the carrier ring
motor
pinion sleeve with magnets (ware, washable)
welded thimble: closed steel cup
dry inner rotor under the deck
the drive passes a closed wall by magnets:
nothing to seal, nothing to leak, the deck
is washed as one smooth sheet
WHAT TURNING DOES (the hand is free meanwhile)
kneading roller on wall pins;
bowl turns 80 rpm, 8 min, 1.6 kg
pins on the
end wall
pancake: ladle pours 100 mL, H1 spins
120 rpm for 3 s → even Ø 220
SPINDLE S: the jug sits on a thimble in a drained pocket
drain
jug Ø 160 with lid: blade, whisk,
slicing and grating discs, spin basket
blade rotor = outer magnet rotor
welded thimble Ø 40
drained pocket Ø 170
0–6000 rpm: parsley, slurry,
batter, sauces in seconds

g.text: 1/4 T0 and H1 hold a loose carrier ring on three rollers; one roller is driven: the board, bowl, plate or pot turns under the hand
2/4 The drive comes through a welded steel cup: a magnet rotor inside, a pinion sleeve outside — no seal, no gap where food can go
3/4 Turning does the long work while the hand is free: kneading under a roller hung on wall pins, spin-spreading pancake batter on H1
4/4 The spindle S spins the jug's blade up to 6000 rpm through the same kind of welded thimble; spills drain from its pocket
